rooms.name: The Observatory
rooms.visual: parallax star vault; proximity constellations; elliptical orbital mechanics
rooms.interaction: Move to bring nearby stars into temporary constellations; transform to alter orbital relationships.

rooms.name: Machine Garden
rooms.visual: recursive stems; branching growth; translucent seed pods
rooms.interaction: Touch plants to grow branches; cross-pollinate two forms to create a hybrid.

rooms.name: Echo Cathedral
rooms.visual: ribbed nave; resonance rings; spectral glass
rooms.interaction: Sound or gesture excites a resonant structure; overlapping tones reveal hidden architectural modes.

rooms.name: Carnival of Thought
rooms.visual: distorted funhouse geometry; kinetic signage; rotating booths
rooms.interaction: Choose a booth; each action changes the rules of another booth, creating playful interference.

rooms.name: The Ocean
rooms.visual: layered fluid fields; pressure haze; caustic light; drifting particles
rooms.interaction: Move horizontally to travel and vertically to change depth; sonar reveals temporary contours.

rooms.name: Living Blueprint
rooms.visual: technical grid; measured vectors; exploded geometry
rooms.interaction: Place constraints and connect components; a viable structure assembles from the drawing.

rooms.name: Dream Library
rooms.visual: floating shelves; impossible staircases; book constellations
rooms.interaction: Follow a volume by sensory clue; opening it changes nearby shelf topology and reveals a fragment.

rooms.name: Signal Forest
rooms.visual: layered canopy; branching antennae; wind-borne light
rooms.interaction: Send a signal from one tree; trace how it propagates and changes through the canopy.

rooms.name: Impossible Museum
rooms.visual: non-Euclidean galleries; contradictory frames; impossible thresholds
rooms.interaction: Select two conflicting exhibits and rotate perspective until both interpretations can coexist.

rooms.name: The Composer
rooms.visual: radial notation; gesture trails; luminous score lines
rooms.interaction: Drag to compose motifs; position changes pitch and geometry; layer motifs into a score.

rooms.name: Music Room
rooms.visual: stage lighting; waveform curtains; tactile instrument panels
rooms.interaction: Select and sequence original project audio; inspect track relationships and sound layers.

rooms.name: The Mind
rooms.visual: branching thought map; layered translucent planes
rooms.interaction: Move between thought, sensation, context, and interpretation without collapsing them into one label.

rooms.name: Unreliable Observatory
rooms.visual: unstable star charts; shifting horizon; unreliable instruments
rooms.interaction: Compare readings from instruments that disagree; calibrate without erasing disagreement.

rooms.name: Self Cartographer
rooms.visual: editable layered self-map; nested regions; movable landmarks
rooms.interaction: Build a map from chosen dimensions; every label remains revisable and user-owned.

rooms.name: Image Organism
rooms.visual: procedural morphology; cellular patterns; evolving image organisms
rooms.interaction: Change environmental parameters and observe form emerge; save seeds to branch variations.

rooms.name: Research Atlas
rooms.visual: source constellations; claim graphs; uncertainty bands
rooms.interaction: Move from observation to claim to hypothesis; inspect provenance and competing explanations.

rooms.name: Archive
rooms.visual: stratified shelves; dated layers; artifact thumbnails
rooms.interaction: Filter by time, medium, theme, and provenance; open an artifact without losing its place.

rooms.name: Leave a Fragment
rooms.visual: fragment wall; branching prompt slips; visible provenance
rooms.interaction: Compose a fragment, inspect the prepared handoff, and choose whether to send it; no automatic submission.

rooms.name: The Weather Inside a Bell
rooms.visual: bell-shaped atmosphere; pressure contours; suspended rain
rooms.interaction: Change pressure and watch weather form inside the bell; tap to send a wave through the atmosphere.

rooms.name: Afterbell
rooms.visual: residual rings; fading light; ghost geometry
rooms.interaction: Trigger an event, then navigate only by its fading traces.

rooms.name: Rain Organ
rooms.visual: rainfall columns; resonant gutters; water-driven keys
rooms.interaction: Route drops through channels to play layered tones and rhythms.

rooms.name: Afterimage Orchard
rooms.visual: ghost fruit; photographic persistence; branching paths
rooms.interaction: Move through light trails; linger to develop an afterimage into a new branch.

rooms.name: Cloud Press
rooms.visual: atmospheric press; soft mechanical plates; cloud typography
rooms.interaction: Compress and release cloud masses; pressure changes density, shape, and printed traces.

rooms.name: Moth Dial
rooms.visual: radial dial; moth-wing symmetry; lamp halo
rooms.interaction: Rotate a dial to redirect moths and light; observe attraction, avoidance, and orbit.

rooms.name: The Orchard That Remembers Rain
rooms.visual: rain-memory rings; fruiting branches; water-marked surfaces
rooms.interaction: Rain changes the orchard; revisit a branch to read where water fell and what grew.

rooms.name: Pressure Garden
rooms.visual: inflatable botanical forms; pressure vessels; elastic stems
rooms.interaction: Apply pressure to one region and watch neighboring structures respond through coupled constraints.

rooms.name: Night Shift Orchard
rooms.visual: night work lights; orchard rows; long shadows
rooms.interaction: Move between tasks and watch the orchard change under a limited night shift; prioritize without a perfect view.

rooms.name: The House That Forgets Gravity
rooms.visual: tilting rooms; suspended furniture; architectural drift
rooms.interaction: Reorient the house; objects retain momentum and settle according to the new gravity vector.

rooms.name: Connections
rooms.visual: compact puzzle board; crisp grouping feedback
rooms.interaction: Group related items; require a reasoned grouping and allow deliberate revision.

rooms.name: The Mission
rooms.visual: mission map; route nodes; resource and capacity indicators
rooms.interaction: Navigate service-to-civilian transition choices; decisions reveal dependencies and next steps.

rooms.name: The Service Corridor
rooms.visual: a crooked passage behind the wallpaper; distressed institutional fragments, handbill typography, doors that reveal practical support only after entry
rooms.interaction: Choose a passage into housing, benefits, health, records, education, or the existing Veteran Mission; follow official references without treating the site as a government service

rooms.name: The World
rooms.visual: navigable terrain; layered biomes; distant landmarks
rooms.interaction: Explore by movement and discovery; landmarks change the map and open linked experiences.

rooms.name: Composition Field
rooms.visual: spatial composition surface; movable forms; generative balance
rooms.interaction: Arrange forms and forces; the composition responds to tension, spacing, and rhythm.

rooms.name: The Unmapped
rooms.visual: unknown terrain; incomplete contours; generative negative space
rooms.interaction: Discover the rules through experimentation; the system reveals no tutorial until a pattern is found.

rooms.name: The Picture House
rooms.visual: single widescreen projection framed by distressed paper, handbill typography, and a hand-built cinema poster
rooms.interaction: Play the featured film in the embedded player; the published featured-film configuration replaces the program without changing the room

rooms.name: The Body Archive
rooms.visual: a field notebook crossed with a biological specimen archive; layered evidence slips and a living timeline
rooms.interaction: Record dated observations, measurements, context, interpretations, confidence, and clinician questions; export a raw archive or a concise clinician note

rooms.name: Common Thread
rooms.visual: a hand-drawn constellation of human, spatial, and conceptual relationships; crooked lines and layered paper
rooms.interaction: Add people, places, groups, projects, questions, and resources; connect a new point to an existing one and export the local constellation

rooms.name: The Signal Loom
rooms.visual: evidence threads, dated traces, fine-grained labels, and a restrained intensity plot
rooms.interaction: Add a dated body signal, measurement, intervention response, context, interpretation, or clinician question; filter the evidence ledger and export a source-preserving summary.

rooms.name: After the Uniform
rooms.visual: distressed field notebook, torn-paper panels, service-to-civilian transition fragments, handbill typography
rooms.interaction: Choose a pressure area and horizon, record the situation, obstacle, support needed, and one next move; save locally or export the notes.

rooms.name: Character Atelier
rooms.visual: moth-like character forms, translucent wing geometry, botanical shadow, and a hand-built palette editor
rooms.interaction: Name a character, choose its seed symbol and visual grammar, then propose and explicitly accept symbolic evolution. Every appearance choice remains manually controlled.
